market_summary: Nifty rose 0.38% to 25,387 and Sensex 0.52% to 82,532 on Tue 17 Nov, a second day of gains, with Bank Nifty at a record 62,273 (+1.1%) as PSU banks and realty rose about 2% while IT fell 0.9%; breadth was slightly negative (2,012 up, 2,148 down). Provisional data shows foreign investors bought ₹4,195 cr and domestic funds ₹197 cr, extending November's record foreign buying; India VIX was about 15.2 in early trade (no close found). US tech stocks fell sharply on Monday on AI worries, and the results season is over, so stock moves now come from broker notes rather than new results.

buy_ideas.name: Hitachi Energy India
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 64% and profit up 21%; new orders up 86%, taking the order book to ₹33,300 cr. IDBI Capital's target is 24.6% above the price.
buy_ideas.risks: Price is implied from the stated 24.6% upside, so check the live quote. Very expensive stock, and profit grew much slower than revenue. Large swings on any order or margin news.

buy_ideas.name: ABB India
buy_ideas.target_source: Motilal Oswal (upgraded to Buy from Neutral)
buy_ideas.thesis: September-quarter revenue up 12% and profit up 8%, with a record order book up 36% to about ₹12,900 cr. Motilal upgraded to Buy; its target is 18.5% above the price.
buy_ideas.risks: Margin fell 70 bps and profit growth was modest. Valued at about 60 times 2028 earnings. Price implied from the stated upside.

buy_ideas.name: KPR Mill
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 20% and profit up 58% year on year. ICICI Direct's target is 15% above the price.
buy_ideas.risks: Smaller upside than the others, and textiles depend on export demand and cotton prices. Price implied from the stated upside.

buy_ideas.name: WeWork India Management
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 34% and profit more than tripled. ICICI Securities' target is 34% above the price, the largest upside on this list.
buy_ideas.risks: Recently listed with a short record; office-leasing demand and lease costs drive results, and profit is growing from a small base. Price implied from the stated upside.

avoid.reason: Jumped about 13% on 17 Nov after JM Financial said 'the worst is over', but EBITDA fell, gross margin dropped 1.5 points to 35.1%, and JM cut its target to ₹245 from ₹255 and its FY27 EBITDA estimate by about 18%. Don't chase the spike.
